import os,re,base64,json,hashlib
f=open('inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw','rb');out=os.environ['OUT'];report=[]

open(out+'/mail_extract.json','w').write(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps([{k:v for k,v in x.items() if k!='body'} for x in report],indent=2))
